dedupe_keys.name: ecoembes transparency portal spain household packaging collection sorting and recycling data 2025 and history 1999 2024 finances and green dot fees

description: Ecoembes is the non-profit collective scheme through which companies in Spain meet their extended producer responsibility for household packaging, and since 2024 for commercial and industrial packaging, and its transparency portal publishes data on the system. The pages read on 2026-09-28 explain that Ecoembes pays local authorities the extra cost of separately collecting light household packaging, meaning plastic, paper and cardboard, cans and cartons, which members' declarations put at about 8% of the weight of municipal waste in Spain. The data section has pages for 2025 on member companies, declared packaging, collection, recycling and socio-environmental impact, and a history from 1999 to 2024 covering declarations, prevention, collection, sorting and recycling, with links to official sources on packaging waste; other sections give income and expenses, the Green Dot fee calculation and annual accounts. Coverage is Spain. Access is free; no licence is stated, and whether the figures can be downloaded as tables was not checked. Caveats: figures come from the scheme operator and cover only packaging declared by its members. It supports waste service capacity studies, such as relating selective collection volumes to sorting plant capacity by region. Related record: Sweden's deposit return statistics.
